name: Handoff
description: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document a fresh agent can pick up, saved outside the workspace with secrets redacted.
longDescription: Invoked by hand as `/handoff`, it writes a summary of the current conversation to the OS temporary directory, never the workspace. The document carries a **suggested skills** section naming what the next agent should load, references existing specs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits and diffs by path or URL instead of copying them, and redacts API keys, passwords and personal data. An optional argument describes what the next session will focus on, and the summary is tailored to it. Prompt-only: no scripts, no MCP.
